private_positive: Real poll/start_attempt/startup, reserve/complete capture and plan; actual adopt_plan and scoped event/recovery/replan/outbox source registration. No executor/publicconsumer/native execution. Generic APIs need not all become allowed local operations.
negative_cancellation: Only exact task CANCELLED outside scope. No success, retry refill or activation; retain complete original/pools and deny RUNNING/COMPLETED.
local_models: Strict local schemas, six-field route online; actual four-field history.request promotion; actual allowed_error_m and separate expected_duration_s/ordinary_ttl_s. CPU evidence is data, never registered permission.
wait_observation: Both real event backends must be held by the helper thread while the real main worker has entered the genuine job view/transaction. A test-only passthrough observation must identify the exact candidate callsite entering real blocking event-lock acquisition with real job view/txn still held, with main and lock-holder thread/native IDs and ordered barrier/queue events. Only then may the holder advance the appropriate original CPU counter to the exact hard-open boundary and release. A job BEGIN trace or an event announcing intent alone is insufficient. No substituted lock, view, authority verdict or private permission. The author must present this concrete source-level observation seam and cleanup to ROOT before any run; if it cannot demonstrate entry without changing authority, STOP for another plan rather than claim coverage.
wait_exact_callsite: Saved real event lock acquire builtin self + actual _local_publication_scope generator frame/view + actual SQLite connection.in_transaction. Holder observes main returned from profile at blocked real acquire, no c_return, then advances original CPU counter and releases.

resource_contract.closure: Every real allocated repository/connection/OC1 clock/session/thread finally cleanup; clocks only issuer thread; bounded joins, job TLS and registry views closed; actual methods/profile restored. Partial unknown is not success.
resource_contract.unpolled_basis: never_polled_no_owned_runtime: actual initial/final active_job_id empty string, no owned session/heartbeat observed, no fake close.
